author: aarshshahoffchain
content:
Hey <@1000001410538151996> 

I came across a bug in the Lighthouse Gloas partial columns code while doing Kurtosis inter-op testing:

LH defines the Partial Column GroupId as {slot, beacon_block_root} at https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/fa18cdb9ea4eecaad920f67e52a2013e53b3e8c3/consensus/types/src/data/partial_data_column_sidecar.rs#L336-L340

But, the spec says it's {beacon_block_root, slot} at https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.0/specs/gloas/partial-columns/p2p-interface.md#modified-partialdatacolumngroupid  which is what we've implemented in Prysm.

author: aarshshahoffchain
content: Would you be able to patch this ? I plan to deploy the Gloas partial columns code for Prysm on devnet-8 soon.

author: lucassaldanhaconsensys
content: <@1425510242749251606> we are still falling behind partial column support in Teku, but could you share what kurtosis configuration you are using to run these interop tests? I am keen to try to being Teku up to spec soon.
